subject: Post-call discovery recap + request to schedule VP/CTO alignment to unblock pilot
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sinha <priya@techzen.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Dec 2025 18:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: discovery recap + next steps (VP/CTO alignment)

Hi Priya — thanks again for a productive intro call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum and unblock the pilot: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use case: real-time recommendation scoring in the recommendation pipeline (sub-200ms p95 target).
- Data sensitivity: customer PII in inputs; TechZen requires VPC/private deployment & KMS.
- Scale expectation: ~2M inference requests/day; a mix of short and long sequences.
- Success criteria: latency SLO (p95 < 200ms), predictable cost under $X/token equivalent, and clear auditing for data residency.

Qualification notes
- Procurement timeline: target pilot kickoff in Jan; procurement + security signoff expected in 4–6 weeks.
- Budget: mid-six-figure pilot; exec approval required (VP/product + CTO).

Proposed next steps
1) Schedule a 30–45m VP/CTO alignment call (this is the blocker for legal/procurement). We want to cover architecture, SLO commitments, and commercial runway.
2) Follow with a 60–90m technical deep dive (solutions engineering + infra runbook) to scope the pilot.
3) Share a mutual action plan and security packet (attached).

Suggested windows (PT): Tue 2025-12-15 10:00–11:00, Wed 2025-12-16 14:00–15:00, Thu 2025-12-17 09:00–10:00. If none work, send your VP/CTO availability and we’ll align.

Attached: redwood-mutual-action-plan.xlsx, techzen-security-reqs.pdf
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-redwood-mup
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4831

Agenda for VP/CTO call (30–45m)
- 5m: intros and goals
- 10m: proposed deployment modes + data controls (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
- 10m: performance/latency expectations and SLAs
- 10m: commercial ask and timelines

If you confirm a slot I’ll send calendar invites and loop in Marissa for pilot success criteria and Monica (solutions engineering) for the technical runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to locking time.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Mateo — helpful summary and aligned on the ask. A few quick notes: 

- We're definitely interested. The VP (Anika Rao) and CTO (Rahul Gupta) are the right folks to get unblocked. Rahul also wants the CISO to see the security packet before the exec call. Can you include our CISO (ciso@techzen.co) or share the security slides ahead of time?
- On budget: we are comfortable with a pilot in the mid-six-figure range but Rahuls wants a high-level cost range (ballpark) to present to procurement ahead of the exec sync. A top-level per-month or per-token estimate would be great — we understand this is preliminary.
- Availability: Tue 2025-12-15 10:00–11:00 PT works best for the VP/CTO. For the technical deep dive, Rahul prefers Wed 2025-12-16 14:00–15:30 PT (longer slot).

Can you send updated calendar invitations and a one-page security summary (CISO-friendly)? Also please attach the preliminary pricing band.

—Priya
